subject: Hospitality
title: Event Registration Platforms
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Event Registration Platforms.

hook.text: Eventbrite, Cvent, and Bizzabo process millions of registrations daily. Registration technology replaced paper sign-ups worldwide.

buildup.text: Modern platforms handle ticketing, payments, email marketing, badge printing, check-in, and attendee data—all from one dashboard.

discovery.text: Cvent dominates the MICE sector, managing $15+ billion in event spending annually.

twist.text: Registration data is hugely valuable: attendee demographics, preferences, and behavior inform marketing long after the event ends.

climax.text: Privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA) now govern how event data is collected and used.

punchline.text: One platform: tickets, emails, badges, data. Registration tech replaced chaos.

quiz.question: Why is event registration data so valuable?
options: Attendee demographics, preferences, and behavior inform marketing long after the event ends
